race.comment: SIPPING SHAMUS (5) has form which doesn't look great on paper but remember some of it is out of metro Highways. Even then he has not been beaten that far in them. He draws the right marble to do no work early and give you a great sight. BAMBOULA (1) did very little wrong when last racing. It has been a long time however, since he raced. Must have shown them enough to still keep going as a 7yo. MARINERA (3) won last week and goes around again. She has backed up successfully beforehand. Not the prettiest barrier though. SHIPSHAPE (10) found an easier contest at Dubbo to win at recently. He at least got some confidence from it. RULE OF FAITH (7) needs to repeat the effort from two back to be competitive.
